clues.text: His father Gilead's other sons drove him out, saying he was the son of another woman.
After fleeing his brothers to the land of Tob, this man of Gilead gathered worthless men around him.
When the Ammonites made war on Israel, the elders of Gilead came asking this man to be their commander.
Before fighting the Ammonites, he vowed a burnt offering of whatever came out his door to greet him.
Returning victorious to Mizpah, this judge saw his only child, a daughter, coming out with tambourines and dancing.
The men of Ephraim threatened to burn his house down with him inside for fighting the Ammonites without them.
A New Testament roll of the faithful names him alongside Gideon, Barak, Samson, David and Samuel.
